family.tagline: Drums in the den, chisels in the workshop, files at home.
family.story: Wojtek restores furniture in the workshop on the lower level. Beatriz manages a dental office and the family calendar. Three kids, a drum kit and one Companion Core fill the house.

companion.name: Bartek
companion.job: Opens Twenty in its own browser and logs each new commission.
companion.limits: Logs what Wojtek dictates. He reviews the entry.

companion.name: Lia
companion.job: Drafts the family calendar and appointment notes from what Beatriz texts it.
companion.limits: Drafts only. Beatriz confirms every date.

popup.title: A parcel at the stoop
popup.body: A parcel waits at the top of the stoop. Wojtek has carried worse up it. He takes this one through the foyer and living room to the kitchen shelf.

popup.title: Unpacking the parcel
popup.body: Zofia unpacks the parcel: the Companion Core, a power cable, a quick-start guide and a recovery USB drive. The Core covers about three quarters of a sheet of paper.

popup.title: A cable, a button, a Core
popup.body: Davi plugs in the cable and presses the button. The Core wakes and opens a Wi-Fi network of its own.

popup.title: The phone finds the Core
popup.body: On his phone, Wojtek joins the Core's own Wi-Fi network, then picks the home network.

popup.title: First agents, first apps
popup.body: In Companion Hub, Beatriz picks Hermes and Wojtek picks OpenClaw. They add Companion Memory (beta), Twenty and PhotoPrism, then leave it to work.

beats.capability: an agent with its own browser and coding tools, running in its own sandbox

popup.title: Bartek reports for work
popup.body: Wojtek sends the first message to Bartek, the agent he named. Bartek answers, and the Core is running.

say.speaker: wojtek
say.text: Good morning, Wojtek. I am Bartek. What is the first job?

beats.capability: talks to you through the messaging platform you pick

popup.title: Lia drafts the week
popup.body: Beatriz texts Lia the week's appointments. Lia drafts the calendar, and Beatriz confirms every date in Baikal.
popup.note: Messages pass through the chat service you choose.

say.speaker: beatriz
say.text: Here is the week as a draft. Please check each date.

beats.capability: keeps your digital life on your own disk; imports are opt-in

popup.title: Beatriz chooses what to connect
popup.body: Beatriz opens Companion Memory and chooses what to connect. Nothing is connected by default, and she can remove a source later.

beats.capability: a recipe book and an expiry tracker

popup.title: Sunday dinner, with an expiry date
popup.body: Wojtek puts Sunday's dinner in the HomeHub recipe book. Beatriz checks the expiry tracker first, so the oldest vegetables get cooked first.

beats.capability: send files between phones and laptops on the same Wi-Fi

popup.title: From his phone to the laptop
popup.body: Davi sends last night's drum take from his phone to the family laptop with PairDrop. The file travels over the home Wi-Fi.

beats.capability: edit audio in a browser tab. Cut, fade, normalise, export

popup.title: A drum take, trimmed
popup.body: Davi cuts and fades the take in AudioMass, an audio editor in a browser tab. The drums stay in the Den.

beats.capability: stream your own movies, shows and music to every screen in the house

popup.title: Choosing the film takes longer
popup.body: Rafa takes a long time to choose a film in Jellyfin. The Den TV plays it from the family's library on the Core.

beats.capability: stream your own music from your Core to a browser or an app

popup.title: Playback on the couch
popup.body: On the couch, Davi plays last night's takes back through mStream. It streams his music from the Core to his phone.

beats.capability: keep customers, deals and custom fields in a CRM you host yourself

popup.title: Bartek logs the sideboard
popup.body: A walnut sideboard arrives. Wojtek dictates the job, and Bartek opens Twenty in its own browser to log it. Wojtek reviews the entry.

say.speaker: wojtek
say.text: Commission logged. Please check the entry.

beats.capability: browse and share your photo library, with automatic tagging

popup.title: The sideboard gets a photo album
popup.body: Wojtek adds the day's pictures of the sideboard to PhotoPrism. It tags them automatically, without uploading them anywhere.

beats.capability: a real-time Kanban board for a team or a family project

popup.title: The job board moves a card
popup.body: Wojtek drags the sideboard's card from Stripping to Finishing on a Planka board. Beatriz sees the same board on her phone.

beats.capability: merge, split, compress and convert PDFs on your own Core

popup.title: Quote and terms in one PDF
popup.body: Beatriz merges the sideboard's quote and terms into one PDF with Stirling-PDF. The merge runs on the Core.

beats.capability: invoicing, expenses, customers and profit and loss for a small business

popup.title: Friday means invoices
popup.body: On Friday, Beatriz writes the sideboard's invoice in Akaunting. The invoice, the customer and the books all sit on the Core.

beats.capability: read Wikipedia and other reference sites

popup.title: A bike repair with a reference
popup.body: Rafa looks up how a bike gear works in Kiwix, the bicycle upside down in the garage. The reference pages sit on the Core.

beats.capability: turn habits and chores into a game with levels and quests

popup.title: Chores become a quest
popup.body: The chore list is a quest now. Rafa beats the laundry dragon in Habitica, which turns habits and chores into levels.

beats.capability: a whiteboard with a hand-drawn look. Sketch ideas together

popup.title: The dragon gets drawn
popup.body: Zofia sketches the laundry dragon on an Excalidraw whiteboard. The hand-drawn look suits a creature with five legs.

beats.capability: a local video recorder with object detection for your IP cameras

popup.title: The stoop camera files its clips
popup.body: Wojtek mounts an IP camera at the top of the stoop. It streams to Frigate, and the clips stay on the Core.

beats.capability: save places on a map and plan multi-day trips with a budget

popup.title: The summer trip, planned outside
popup.body: On the terrace, Beatriz plans the summer trip in TRIP: places pinned on a map and days put in order.

popup.title: A loud house, one calm Core
popup.body: The Kowalczyk-Ferreira household of five runs its commissions, calendars and drum takes from one Core on a kitchen shelf.

closing.body: Your next commission, its photos and its invoice can live on a Companion Core at home. Browse the Companion Hub store and pick your first apps.

notes: FTUE follows the owner's hotspot flow (STORY-BIBLE section 7); owner sign-off against the fact sheet is still open.
ftue-hello uses OpenClaw (Bartek), so the Hermes disclosure note sits on kitchen-lia, the first Hermes beat.
garden-stoop assumes the family owns an IP camera: it is not in the Core parcel and not in the 3D scene. No claim that it prevents anything.
The front door is above ground (a stoop up through terraced planters); ftue-delivery tells the carry to the kitchen shelf.
Davi's takes: no claim about who can or cannot open them. Invented place and street: check Brindle Falls and Tamarack Court against a map.
